GRADE 4 CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Percussion Musical Instruments at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify indigenous percussion musical instruments from different Kenyan communities,
   B. Learners should ignore Percussion Musical Instruments completely.
   C. Percussion Musical Instruments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Percussion Musical Instruments.

2. About Percussion Musical Instruments at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. classify indigenous Kenyan percussion musical instruments, as melodic or non-melodic
   B. Learners should ignore Percussion Musical Instruments completely.
   C. Percussion Musical Instruments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Percussion Musical Instruments.

3. About Percussion Musical Instruments when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss the function(s) of parts of a percussion musical instrument,
   B. Learners should ignore Percussion Musical Instruments completely.
   C. Percussion Musical Instruments is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Percussion Musical Instruments.

5. About Netball at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss the skills of passing and catching in Netball,
   B. Learners should ignore Netball completely.
   C. Netball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Netball.

6. About Netball at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. make a ball using macramé technique,
   B. Learners should ignore Netball completely.
   C. Netball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Netball.

7. About Netball when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the skills of passing, and catching in Netball,
   B. Learners should ignore Netball completely.
   C. Netball is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Netball.

9. About Painting and Montage at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. classify colours into primary and secondary for painting,
   B. Learners should ignore Painting and Montage completely.
   C. Painting and Montage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Painting and Montage.

10. About Painting and Montage at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. paint a picture for colour value application,
   B. Learners should ignore Painting and Montage completely.
   C. Painting and Montage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Painting and Montage.

11. About Painting and Montage when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. create a montage composition for expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Painting and Montage completely.
   C. Painting and Montage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Painting and Montage.

13. About Rhythm at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret rhythmic patterns involving the crotchet, pair of quaver and their rests,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

14. About Rhythm at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. write the French rhythm taa and ta-te, names using free hand lettering,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

15. About Rhythm when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the qualities of a good rhythmic pattern,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

17. About Melody at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify sol-fa syllables d r m in a simple melody,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

18. About Melody at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret hand signs for the sol-fa syllables d r m for pitch discrimination,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

19. About Melody when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. state the qualities of a good melody as a foundation to composition,
   B. Learners should ignore Melody completely.
   C. Melody is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Melody.

21. About Athletics at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss the sprint starts and sprinting techniques in athletics,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

22. About Athletics at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the sprint starts and sprinting techniques for skill development,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

23. About Athletics when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. paint the Kenyan flag for an athletic event,
   B. Learners should ignore Athletics completely.
   C. Athletics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Athletics.

25. About Gymnastics at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain a crab balance and a side roll in gymnastics,
   B. Learners should ignore Gymnastics completely.
   C. Gymnastics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Gymnastics.

26. About Gymnastics at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the crab balance for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Gymnastics completely.
   C. Gymnastics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Gymnastics.

27. About Gymnastics when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. execute the side roll for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Gymnastics completely.
   C. Gymnastics is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Gymnastics.

29. About Songs at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. sing different types of songs applying performance techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Songs completely.
   C. Songs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Songs.

30. About Songs at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the East African Community Anthem in unison,
   B. Learners should ignore Songs completely.
   C. Songs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Songs.

31. About Songs when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify types of folk songs performed by indigenous Kenyan communities,
   B. Learners should ignore Songs completely.
   C. Songs is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Songs.

33. About Photography at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify digital devices for photography,
   B. Learners should ignore Photography completely.
   C. Photography is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Photography.

34. About Photography at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss elements of photography for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Photography completely.
   C. Photography is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Photography.

35. About Photography when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. take photographs using digital devices,
   B. Learners should ignore Photography completely.
   C. Photography is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Photography.

37. About Descant Recorder at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the parts of a descant recorder for familiarisation,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

38. About Descant Recorder at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. care for a descant recorder for longevity,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

39. About Descant Recorder when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. play notes B A and G on a descant recorder using appropriate playing techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Descant Recorder completely.
   C. Descant Recorder is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Descant Recorder.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Percussion Musical Instruments at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Netball at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Painting and Montage at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Rhythm at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Melody at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Athletics at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Gymnastics at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Songs at home with your family.

36. Give two examples of how you can use Photography at home with your family.

40. Give two examples of how you can use Descant Recorder at home with your family.
